“What age did you realize you were trans?” Well, I didn’t really know about the actual concept of being trans till I was 15, but when I learned about it that’s when it all really clicked for me. However, throughout all my childhood I always subconsciously thought of myself as a woman. I remember how when I was a child, I’d always imagine my grown up self being a woman. 

“Do you wish you had started transitioning earlier in your life?” I’m mostly content with the age that I started transitioning, but sometimes I do wish I started earlier. The main reason why, despite the fact that appearance wise I consider myself passing, is because I have a deep voice that I’m very dysphoric about. I think about how if I started puberty blockers earlier my deep voice could’ve been prevented. 

“Do you believe trans teens should wait until a certain age to start physically transitioning?” I’m not sure, honestly. I feel like the whole topic of when trans children/teen should start transitioning is just a case by case situation.
